name: ChiLab Studio

deck.label: What we do

capabilities: Sand casting, lost wax, lost PLA, resin bonded sand, match plate patterns. Bronze, aluminum, iron.
Kiln cast glass, lead crystal, slumped and fused glass, cold working and polishing, architectural lamination with partners.
Hot and cold patina, plating and anodizing coordination, custom color development, outdoor rated coatings.
Parametric modeling in Grasshopper, 3D scanning and reverse engineering, CNC routing and machining, in house 3D printing.
Welded and machined assemblies, architectural stairs and screens, structural coordination with engineers of record.
Documentation of historic profiles, reproduction of missing ornament, code and ADA upgrades that keep period character.
Budgeting, prototyping, mockups and samples, shop drawings, permitting support, sequencing, and site installation.
studio_body: ChiLab Studio began as a collaboration between friends from different disciplines. Driven by a mutual interest in giving everyday objects and public experiences more care, the ChiLab think tank has grown into an award winning specialty project studio and a working part of the Chicago design and arts communities.

We bring artists' and designers' visions to life through bespoke project development and artisanal fabrication. Our team works closely with clients to understand what they are after, providing guidance and support through the whole process, and we partner with a network of specialists and industrial manufacturers so that every part of a project holds to the same standard.

True to the beginning, we welcome collaboration and take on commissions on a per project basis. Whether a client needs fine art fabrication, custom furniture and accessories, artisanal finishes and details, or project management support, we have the expertise and the shop to make it happen.

The studio was founded in 2013 by Ben Stagl and Ally Reza. Ben holds an MFA in Sculpture from the School of the Art Institute of Chicago and a BFA in Sculpture from Oregon State University, and teaches in SAIC's Architecture, Interior Architecture, and Designed Objects program. Ally leads the studio's glass practice, which runs from lead crystal casting to large format architectural glass.

news.title: Tulips on The Magnificent Mile
news.text: Five tulip sculptures installed along Michigan Avenue with The Magnificent Mile Association and CNL Projects, timed to the city's annual spring bloom.

news.title: Flight of Butterflies opens at Peggy Notebaert Nature Museum
news.text: Twenty nine monumental butterfly sculptures placed across Chicago, from the Magnificent Mile to neighborhood parks, each finished by a local artist with fabrication support and studio space from ChiLab.

news.title: Chicago communities use art to highlight climate issues
news.text: E(art)h Chicago installed twelve works across city neighborhoods. ChiLab fabricated Leonard Suryajaya's Homebound for the Grant Park waterfront.

news.title: O'Hare Terminal 5 expansion unveils a murmuration
news.text: The Chicago Department of Cultural Affairs and Special Events and the Chicago Department of Aviation unveiled Jina Valentine's 450 foot installation, fabricated and installed by ChiLab.

news.title: Knoll unveils new Chicago showroom at Fulton Market
news.text: The showroom opened at 811 W Fulton with a ChiLab marquee screen in chrome and dark bronze, and was named to Chicago's coolest offices lists that year.

news.title: Newcity Design Issue
news.text: ChiLab Studio recognized in Newcity's annual survey of the people shaping design in Chicago.
